description: Search and filter U.S. colleges and universities by name, location, type, size, and acceptance rate. Returns core identity and cost metrics. Use scorecard_get_school for profiles or scorecard_search_programs for program rankings. Geographic distance requires a U.S. ZIP; ZIP alone uses the provider default radius. State accepts comma-separated two-letter codes (e.g. WA,CA). Ownership: 1=public, 2=private nonprofit, 3=for-profit. Degree level: 0=non-degree, 1=certificate, 2=associate, 3=bachelor, 4=graduate.

acceptance_rate_range.description: Acceptance rate range as decimals (0–1). Omit for no filter.

max.description: Maximum acceptance rate as a decimal (e.g. 0.9 for 90%).

min.description: Minimum acceptance rate as a decimal (e.g. 0.1 for 10%).

cip_code.description: Filter to schools offering this CIP 4-digit program code (e.g. "11.07"). Use scorecard_lookup_cip to find codes.

distance.description: Nonnegative radius: bare miles, mi, or km, including decimals. Requires meaningful zip.

men_only.description: True selects men-only institutions; false selects institutions explicitly marked not men-only. Omit to include unknown values.

query.description: School name search — partial or full name; all words must appear.

size_range.description: Undergraduate enrollment size range. Omit for no size filter.

sort.description: Upstream sort expression on an indexed field, e.g. "latest.cost.avg_net_price.overall:asc" or ":desc" for reverse order. Use scorecard_list_fields for sort support; omission keeps API ordering.

state.description: Comma-separated two-letter state codes; case and whitespace normalized, blanks unset.

women_only.description: True selects women-only institutions; false selects institutions explicitly marked not women-only. Omit to include unknown values.

zip.description: Five-digit U.S. ZIP or ZIP+4. Alone uses the provider default radius; blank is unset.

name: scorecard_search_schools

cap.description: The per_page limit that was applied.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_conflict`: The provider reported a request conflict. `api_invalid_params`: Provider rejected a query parameter. `api_validation`: A meaningful selector or provider value is invalid. `api_unauthorized`: The provider rejected the API credentials. `api_forbidden`: The provider denied access. `api_rate_limited`: The provider throttled the request. `api_timeout`: The provider exchange exceeded its deadline. `api_not_found`: The provider endpoint returned HTTP 404. `api_invalid_request`: The provider returned an unexpected redirect. `api_internal`: The provider returned an unclassified HTTP response. `api_error`: The College Scorecard API returned an error. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery hint when results are empty — echoes applied filters and suggests how to broaden.

query.description: Normalized effective selectors and pagination defaults.

admission_rate.description: Overall admission rate (0–1). Null if not reported.

id.description: Unit ID — use for scorecard_get_school lookups.

ownership.description: Control type: Public, Private nonprofit, or For-profit.

total.description: Total institutions matching the filters (before pagination).

totalCount.description: Total institutions matching the filters, before pagination.

truncated.description: True when school pagination metadata indicates a later page exists.

title: Search Schools
